title: JavaScript Event Loop
subtitle: Edit a small program and follow callbacks through the stack, microtasks and timers.

params.label: Program
params.default:
console.log("start")
setTimeout(() => console.log("timer"), 0)
Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log("promise"))
console.log("end")

simulation.hint: A restricted teaching interpreter. Supports console.log, setTimeout, queueMicrotask and Promise.resolve().then chains. It does not execute arbitrary JavaScript.

edgeCases.label: Nested microtask
edgeCases.why: Microtasks queued while draining run before a timer.
